text: Half the people who reviewed this free demo had already played it for eleven hours. Not one of them quit inside ten minutes. Not one.
sub: Half the people who reviewed this free demo had already played it for eleven hours. Not one of them quit inside ten minutes. Not one.

text: And the people leaving negative reviews had played longer than the people leaving positive ones.
sub: And the people leaving negative reviews had played longer than the people leaving positive ones.

text: Guildrun is a P v E autobattler roguelike. You build a team, you bend heroes out of their class, and you watch the fight resolve itself.
sub: Guildrun is a PvE autobattler roguelike. You build a team, you bend heroes out of their class, and you watch the fight resolve itself.

text: Nearly two thousand reviews, ninety percent positive, and about two and a half thousand people in it as I record this. That's the biggest demo I've taken apart.
sub: Nearly two thousand reviews, ninety percent positive, and about two and a half thousand people in it as I record this. That's the biggest demo I've taken apart.

text: It's also the first one where the file list told me the team had done this before.
sub: It's also the first one where the file list told me the team had done this before.

text: Start with the awkward part. This is an I L two C P P build, so all the C sharp is fused into one Game Assembly file.
sub: Start with the awkward part. This is an IL2CPP build, so all the C# is fused into one GameAssembly file.

text: In the last teardown that was a dead end. There's no folder of package names to read.
sub: In the last teardown that was a dead end. There's no folder of package names to read.

text: Except it isn't quite a dead end. Any assembly that shipped with embedded resources leaves its name behind in a data file, and Steam lists those.
sub: Except it isn't quite a dead end. Any assembly that shipped with embedded resources leaves its name behind in a data file, and Steam lists those.

text: Twenty four names came out. Here's what a team that has shipped before installs.
sub: Twenty four names came out. Here's what a team that has shipped before installs.

text: Sentry, with six assemblies and a native crash handler behind it. They've shipped a patch every single week since January. That's what makes that survivable.
sub: Sentry, with six assemblies and a native crash handler behind it. They've shipped a patch every single week since January. That's what makes that survivable.

text: S Q Lite, because the demo alone has three hundred relics and a hundred items. At some point that stops being a pile of JSON files.
sub: SQLite, because the demo alone has three hundred relics and a hundred items. At some point that stops being a pile of JSON files.

text: N Log for structured logging. R three and System Reactive for event streams. Threading Channels for the producer-consumer work.
sub: NLog for structured logging. R3 and System Reactive for event streams. Threading Channels for the producer-consumer work.

text: And Z Link, which exists for one reason: doing link without allocating. You install that when you've been bitten by garbage collection hitches.
sub: And ZLinq, which exists for one reason: doing LINQ without allocating. You install that when you've been bitten by garbage collection hitches.

text: None of that is exciting. It's the stuff you only know to install because something went wrong on the last project.
sub: None of that is exciting. It's the stuff you only know to install because something went wrong on the last project.

text: Compare the solo demo I took apart two episodes ago. Its entire third party list was one entry: Discord rich presence.
sub: Compare the solo demo I took apart two episodes ago. Its entire third party list was one entry: Discord rich presence.

text: Neither is wrong. But if you're about to start your second project, that list up there is a shopping list.
sub: Neither is wrong. But if you're about to start your second project, that list up there is a shopping list.

text: Audio is F MOD with Resonance, same as the last one. Networking is nanosockets, a thin U D P layer.
sub: Audio is FMOD with Resonance, same as the last one. Networking is nanosockets, a thin UDP layer.

text: Then the number I stared at for a while.
sub: Then the number I stared at for a while.

text: The demo is ten and a half gigabytes on disk. The download is one point one seven.
sub: The demo is ten and a half gigabytes on disk. The download is one point one seven.

text: That's an eighty nine percent saving. Which means the files sitting on your drive are barely compressed at all.
sub: That's an eighty nine percent saving. Which means the files sitting on your drive are barely compressed at all.

text: My first thought was that somebody forgot the import settings. My second thought was to read the store page.
sub: My first thought was that somebody forgot the import settings. My second thought was to read the store page.

text: Minimum requirements: fifteen gigabytes of storage, and a line that says H D D okay, no S S D required.
sub: Minimum requirements: fifteen gigabytes of storage, and a line that says HDD okay, no SSD required.

text: Uncompressed assets cost disk and save C P U. On a hard drive with no decompression to do, they load faster. My read is that this is deliberate.
sub: Uncompressed assets cost disk and save CPU. On a hard drive with no decompression to do, they load faster. My read is that this is deliberate.

text: They spent ten gigabytes of somebody's drive to keep the game playable on old hardware. Tell me in the comments if I've got that backwards.
sub: They spent ten gigabytes of somebody's drive to keep the game playable on old hardware. Tell me in the comments if I've got that backwards.

text: There are also twenty two scenes in here. The last two games I took apart shipped one each and built everything at runtime. This one is authored in the editor.
sub: There are also twenty two scenes in here. The last two games I took apart shipped one each and built everything at runtime. This one is authored in the editor.

text: So the engineering is careful. The fight in the reviews is about something else entirely.
sub: So the engineering is careful. The fight in the reviews is about something else entirely.

text: Performance barely comes up. Ten mentions positive, two negative. Nobody is complaining about the build.
sub: Performance barely comes up. Ten mentions positive, two negative. Nobody is complaining about the build.

text: They're complaining about balance. Certain combinations only, dead heroes, and a random draw that decides your run before you play it.
sub: They're complaining about balance. Certain combinations only, dead heroes, and a random draw that decides your run before you play it.

text: And that's why the negative reviewers had fifteen hours in. You don't find a balance ceiling in an hour. You find it after you've mastered the thing.
sub: And that's why the negative reviewers had fifteen hours in. You don't find a balance ceiling in an hour. You find it after you've mastered the thing.

text: Which is a very different problem from the demos where people quit in the first hour.
sub: Which is a very different problem from the demos where people quit in the first hour.

text: Here's the whole teardown on one card.
sub: Here's the whole teardown on one card.

text: Unity, I L two C P P, C sharp. A stack full of things you only reach for the second time around. Ten gigabytes of deliberately uncompressed art.
sub: Unity, IL2CPP, C#. A stack full of things you only reach for the second time around. Ten gigabytes of deliberately uncompressed art.

text: Worth a dip, and be careful, because eleven hours is the median.
sub: Worth a dip, and be careful, because eleven hours is the median.

text: If you're starting your next project, take the boring half of that list. Crash reporting on day one is the cheapest thing you will ever install.
sub: If you're starting your next project, take the boring half of that list. Crash reporting on day one is the cheapest thing you will ever install.

text: That's my read from the outside. If you made this and I got something wrong, say so and I'll pin the correction. Next time, another demo, another file list. This is Demo Dip.
